_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The status readout's model picker is disabled while the agent works. The screen is 1280x800. "The model" is ".model-picker-inline .p-select-label"; "the picker" is ".model-picker-inline". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. data-testid "message-input" should be visible (allow 30s). 3. The model should be visible, and the picker must not have the class "p-disabled". 4. Fill the message input with "bash: sleep 8" and click data-testid "send-button". 5. data-testid "agent-thinking" should be visible (allow 20s). 6. The picker should have the class "p-disabled". 7. Click where the model is, ignoring that it is disabled: a disabled picker takes no pointer events, so click its wrapper ".status-readout-model" at the model's center (offsets from the wrapper's top-left corner to the center of the model's bounding box). 8. There should be no ".model-picker-panel" (count 0). 9. The model's computed cursor must be exactly "default", and the picker's computed opacity, as a number, must be < 1 and > 0.4. 10. The model's aria-description attribute must contain "switch models". 11. Move the pointer to the viewport point (0, 0) (a hover without a selector), then hover ".status-readout-model": ".p-tooltip-text" should contain "switch models". 12. Move the pointer to the viewport point (0, 0) again: there should be no ".p-tooltip-text" (count 0). 13. Click ".context-usage-label": ".chat-context-popup" should be visible. 14. The first visible ".status-readout-cwd" should be disabled, and the computed text-decoration-line of its ".status-readout-cwd-path" must be exactly "none".

steps.expression: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('.status-readout-model').getBoundingClientRect(); const m = document.querySelector('.model-picker-inline .p-select-label').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(m.x + m.width / 2 - w.x) + ',' + Math.round(m.y + m.height / 2 - w.y); })()
